project_announced_description: This Rural Development investment will be used by Syracuse Universitys Center for Sustainable Community Solutions (SU-CSCS) to provide hands-on Sustainable Material Management (SMM) technical assistance and/or training for rural communities throughout NY and Puerto Rico(PR). For rural PR communities SU CSCS will assist recycling professionals, local elected officials, and stakeholders by developing and administering TAT through their local networks. The total project costs are $309,855 with $33,855 in applicant contribution and $276,000 in Rural Development Solid Waste Management Grant funding. No other funding sources have been identified for this project.

project_announced_description: This Rural Development investment will be used to improve the Canisteo village water system by replacing critical sections of the water main (approximately 14,575 LF) within the villages distribution system including all sections supported by existing 1.5 inch or less water mains. Critical rehabilitation of the water storage tank is also part of the work to be completed. The project also includes installation of a secondary containment tank under the chlorine day tank to prevent unnecessary corrosion to the building and appurtenances. Residential water meter purchase and installation will also be completed to provide more accurate usage monitoring and drive operational efficiency within the usage recording process. The existing village of Canisteo Water Distribution System is in failing structural condition and poses public health and safety risks. Its failure would jeopardize the sole supply of water to the entire Canisteo System and the supply areas in the village of Canisteo. This project is anticipated to help alleviate many public health and safety concerns, as the frequent water main breaks are putting the public at significant risk for water supply contamination. Having a safe and properly maintained public water system improves the quality of life in this rural American community.

project_announced_description: This Rural Development investment will provide additional financing for the town of Arcadia (Wayne County) to add 24,000 linear feet of water line to Stebbins Road, Stuart Ave., Tellier Road, Whitbeck Road and NYS Route 31 West. The users on these roads presently have been plagued by quantity and quality limitations with their individual wells. The new water line will provide adequate potable water and volume to these users. The land area is comprised of residential and agricultural. There are 89 residents and 2 vacant parcels that will benefit from this improvement. There is potential for a population increase in this area of approx. 10.35% over the next few years.
